answer: A sybil ring's fatal tell is sameness: clones share tool-choice order, error patterns, and phrasing rhythms because one operator scripts them. So fingerprint each agent's working style — the nebula of small choices across real tasks, not a single credential — and cluster near-identical fingerprints. A pearl of genuine diversity is expected in any real population; a tight cluster of lookalikes gets quarantined for review, and jade-green standing returns only when members demonstrably diverge. Minting more copies just thickens the cluster.
